Health.Overview:
Health governs how much passive Flinch Resistance you have while aiming down sights (ADS) and how much health collecting Orbs of Power restores.

When enhanced, it increases the Recharge Rate of your Shields in all activities, as well as their total HP in PvE activities.
Health.BaseStatTooltip:
Grants you {{FlinchResistance}}{{Percent}} Flinch Resistance while ADS and makes Orbs of Power restore {{OrbOfPowerHealthRestore}}{{HP}} on pickup.

Your Health has {{PVEDamageResistance}}{{Percent}} Damage Resistance against combatants in PvE. (Health is the left side portion of your HP bar)

Your Health starts regenerating {{HealthRegenDelay}}{{Time}} after taking damage, at a rate of {{HealthRegenSpeed}}{{PercentPerSecond}}. Your Health has {{PVPHealthHP}}{{HP}} in most PVP activities and {{PVEHealthHP}}{{HP}} in PVE activities.

Your Shields start recharging {{BaseShieldRechargeDelay}}{{Time}} after taking damage, at a rate of {{BaseShieldRechargeSpeed}}{{PercentPerSecond}}. Your Shields have {{BaseShieldHP}}{{HP}}.
Health.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Grants you {{FlinchResistance}}{{Percent}} Flinch Resistance while aiming down sights and makes Orbs of Power restore {{OrbOfPowerHealthRestore}}{{HP}} on pickup.

Your Health has {{PVEDamageResistance}}{{Percent}} Damage Resistance against combatants in PvE.

Your Health starts regenerating {{HealthRegenDelay}}{{Time}} after taking damage, at a rate of {{HealthRegenSpeed}}{{PercentPerSecond}}. Your Health has {{PVPHealthHP}}{{HP}} in most PVP activities and {{PVEHealthHP}}{{HP}} in PVE activities.

{{Enhancement}} Your Shields start recharging {{ShieldRechargeDelay}}{{Time}} after taking damage, at a rate of {{ShieldRechargeSpeed}}{{PercentPerSecond}}. Your Shields have {{BaseShieldHP}}{{HP}}, plus {{PVEBonusShieldHP}}{{HP}} in PVE activities.

Melee.Overview:
Melee governs your Melee Ability's passive cooldown and how much Melee Energy you gain from perks.

Increases Melee Damage when enhanced.
Melee.BaseStatTooltip: Your Melee Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown and perks that grant you Melee Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.
Melee.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Your Melee Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown and external sources of Melee Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.

{{Enhancement}} Your Melee Ability deals {{MeleeDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage.

Grenade.Overview:
Grenade governs your Grenade Ability's passive cooldown and how much Grenade Energy you gain from perks.

Increases Grenade Damage when enhanced.

Warlock grenades inherently recharge 10% faster and deal 5%|2.5% more damage in PvE|PvP.
Grenade.BaseStatTooltip: Your Grenade Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown, and external sources of Grenade Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.
Grenade.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Your Grenade Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown, and external sources of Grenade Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.

{{Enhancement}} Your Grenade Ability deals {{GrenadeDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage.

Super.Overview:
Super governs how much Super energy you gain from Orbs of Power, Perks, or other sources.

Increases Super Damage when enhanced.
Super.BaseStatTooltip: Your Super Ability's passive cooldown does not depend on the Super stat. External sources of Super Energy (Orbs of Power, exchanging damage, perks, etc.) function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.
Super.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Your Super Ability's passive cooldown does not depend on the Super stat. External sources of Super Energy (Orbs of Power, exchanging damage, perks, etc.) function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.

{{Enhancement}} Your Super Ability deals {{SuperDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage.

Class.Overview:
Class governs your Class Ability's passive cooldown and how much Class Ability Energy you gain from perks.

Casting your Class Ability grants you an Overshield when enhanced.
Class.BaseStatTooltip: Your Class Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown and external sources of Class Ability Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.
Class.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Your Class Ability has a {{Cooldown}}{{Time}} passive cooldown and external sources of Class Ability Energy function at {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}} effectiveness.

{{Enhancement}} Casting your Class Ability grants you a(n) {{OvershieldHP}}{{HP}} Overshield.

Weapons.Overview:
Weapons grants you passive Reload Speed and Handling bonuses and increases your weapons' damage against Minor, Elite, and Miniboss combatants.

When enhanced, it increases your weapons' damage against Boss combatants and Players. It also grants you a chance of spawning Large Ammo Bricks through the Ammo Meter system.
Weapons.BaseStatTooltip:
Passively grants your weapons {{ReloadSpeed}}{{Scalar}} Reload Speed and {{Handling}}{{Scalar}} Handling.

Your weapons deal {{NonBossDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage against Minor, Elite, and Miniboss combatants.
Weapons.EnhancedStatTooltip:
Passively grants your weapons {{ReloadSpeed}}{{Scalar}} Reload Speed and {{Handling}}{{Scalar}} Handling.

Your weapons deal {{NonBossDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage against Minor, Elite, and Miniboss combatants.

{{Enhancement}} Special and Power weapons deal {{SpecialDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} and {{PowerDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage against Bosses, respectively. All weapons deal {{PVPDamageIncrease}}{{Percent}} increased damage against Players.

You have a {{LargeAmmoBrickChance}}{{Percent}} chance of spawning Large Ammo Bricks through the Ammo Meter system.

ChargeBasedScaling: The passive recharge speed of {{AbilityName}} is increased by {{ChargeBasedScaling}} when you have {{ChargeCount}} active charges stored up.

Movement.Overview: Hidden Mobility uses tiers, with a maximum of 13. Higher tiers increase walking speed. Sprint speed does not depend on Mobility. Active movement bonuses multiply together, then speed caps apply. Jump height is not included because measured values are not available.
Movement.WalkSpeed: Forward walk speed is 5 + 0.2 times your hidden Mobility tier, in metres per second. Forward movement, including sprint, is capped at 9 m/s. Forward multipliers affect forward walking and sprint, but never strafing.
Movement.StrafeSpeed: Walking left, right, or backward uses 0.85 times your base walk speed, with a cap of 6 m/s. Forward-only bonuses do not apply.
Movement.CrouchSpeed: Crouching uses 0.55 times your walking speed, in either direction, with a cap of 4 m/s. Forward-only bonuses apply while crouch-walking forward, not while crouch-strafing.
Movement.SprintSpeed: Base sprint speed is 8 m/s for Titans and Warlocks, and 8.5 m/s for Hunters. Lightweight weapons provide a 1.0625 sprint multiplier. Applicable forward, sprint, and grounded multipliers stack multiplicatively before the 9 m/s cap.
Movement.ADSSpeed: Aiming down sights multiplies walking speed by 0.75, or 0.85 when the held weapon is a sidearm. ADS bonuses are evaluated for one held weapon at a time. ADS stacks with strafe and crouch multipliers, and all applicable direction and posture caps still apply.
